$comment: GENERATED by packages/protocol/scripts/extract-ws-schema.mjs from docs/plan/23-ws-protocol.md §13-15. Do not hand-edit — the markdown is human-authoritative; this file is machine-authoritative and re-derived by `pnpm generate`. A drift test binds the two together.

decimal.description: Arbitrary-precision decimal as a string; never a JSON number.

environment.$comment: Mirrors OpenAPI `Environment` / Postgres `exchange_env` exactly. `paper` is NOT a member: paper trading is the orthogonal boolean `is_paper`, because a paper fill still belongs to a real environment (demo, or live during a replay) and collapsing the two would lose that.

isPaper.description: True when the fill/order came from the paper matcher rather than the exchange. Mirrors the `is_paper` column.

errorCode.$comment: GENERATED from 22-api-openapi.yaml x-error-codes-ws + x-error-codes[surface contains ws]. Do not hand-edit; CI gate error_registry_single_source regenerates and diffs.

spec_hash.description: bars snapshots: the series' bar spec (SR-E12-14).

build_version.description: bars snapshots: the lowest bar builder version among the bars sent (SR-E12-14, §6.1).

include_delta.description: bars snapshots and deltas: echoes the subscription's include_delta, so a kind-4 delta of 0 is never read as real (§6.1).

wt.description: Wall-clock send time; present only on replay frames where `ts` is the recorded time.

rs.description: Replay session id; present only on replay frames.

environments.description: Environments this connection intends to observe; intersected with the token's grants.

items.description: Closed set: OpenAPI RoleName / role_name enum (22-api-openapi.yaml) and CONSTITUTION C-12.4 (Owner, Manager, Viewer); custom roles are out of scope for v1.
Closed set: OpenAPI RoleName / role_name enum (22-api-openapi.yaml) and CONSTITUTION C-12.4 (Owner, Manager, Viewer); custom roles are out of scope for v1.

options.description: Union of universal and topic-specific options. Unknown keys are rejected with `invalid_options`.

time_bucket_ms.description: Client SHOULD derive this per §6.1.1 rather than sending a constant; 500 is the non-visual-client fallback.

paused.description: Client-side pause; the server stops emitting but keeps state.

resnapshot.description: When true, a fresh `snap` follows and prior state must be discarded.

xu.description: Bybit orderbook update id `u`, for diagnostics only.

bids.description: Descending by price. Size "0" deletes the level.

asks.description: Ascending by price. Size "0" deletes the level.

side.description: Taker/aggressor side, taken directly from Bybit `S`.

dropped.description: Prints filtered out by `min_size` since the previous frame; never silent.

generation.description: ADR-0033 series generation (= epoch): an opaque id that a builder cold start or a rebuild replaces, normally with a higher one; index restarts inside it. Compare for equality only: a change in either direction is a new epoch. Never read it as a time. Part of the coalescing key (§8.2).

index.description: Bar index, strictly increasing within a generation; with generation, the coalescing key (§8.2). t_ms may repeat for non-time bars.

turnover.description: Price × qty, an exact decimal string. CVWB kind 4 rounds it half-even to qty_scale (§3.4).

confirm.description: False for the in-progress bar. A client MUST NOT treat it as closed.

amended.description: Optional. True when a late trade re-closed an already-confirmed bar at this (generation, index); the client replaces the stored bar by key and re-renders (§8.2). Structured payloads only: binary records carry no amended bit, so a frame that carries an amended close is always sent structured, even on a binary subscription (§3.4).

generation.description: ADR-0033 series generation (= epoch), as for the `bars[]` item (§14.3): an opaque id that a builder cold start or a rebuild replaces, normally with a higher one; index restarts inside it. Compare for equality only: a change in either direction is a new epoch. Never read it as a time. Part of the bar key (§8.2).

index.description: Bar index, strictly increasing within a generation; with generation, the bar key (§8.2), which also joins this bar to the same bar on the series' bars topic (§6.1). t_ms may repeat for non-time bars.

bid_volume.description: Volume traded into the bid (taker sells).

ask_volume.description: Volume traded into the ask (taker buys).

time_bucket_ms.description: Effective bucket in force, echoing what the client derived per §6.1.1 (or 500 if the client sent none).

bids.description: Resting bid size per price row, ascending from `price_min`.

complete.description: False while the time bucket is still accumulating.

estimated.description: True for heuristic metrics (iceberg, stop_run, absorption, exhaustion).

meta.description: Event detail for event-like metrics, e.g. {price, side, reloads}.

note.description: Bybit batches at most one allLiquidation push per symbol per 500 ms; counts are lower bounds.

change.description: What caused this frame; drives UI animation and the order-timeline widget.

removed.description: Order ids that left the open set (terminal state) and may be dropped from the live view.

trailing_stop.description: Price distance, not a percentage (Bybit semantics).

native_stop_present.description: False violates the safety invariant (arch P4); the OMS re-asserts the stop and raises a critical alert.

removed.description: Positions that went flat; applied after this frame's `positions` upserts.

exec_id.description: Exchange fill id; unique, used for dedupe.

risk_cap_usage.description: Live usage against the account profile's risk caps; drives the risk gauge.

next_eligible_fire_at_ms.description: Set while a cooldown guard is active.

events.description: Present only when subscribed with include_events: true.

dropped_messages.description: Non-zero is an incident, not a warning.

regions.description: Parallel charts only: region id -> active top-level state of that region.

degraded.description: chain_trips latch: order-path commands are refused until acknowledged.
